note: Spacing set from a raw length instead of a --space-* step. A ceiling, not a target: this list may SHRINK and may never grow. A new entry is reported as unexpected and fails; an entry that stops matching is reported as stale and also fails, so a fixed one cannot be left behind as slack for the next author.
why: Reviewed 2026-09-23: every package spacing value is on the --space-* ladder, a control or row inset, or arithmetic over the geometry it clears. What is left is page-level rhythm above the ladder's top step: the main/aside column gap (--layout-column-gap, 32px, a documented layout knob) and the preview site's own section and pager margins.
